research.facts:
Antonelli Championship Math
**Source:** Crash.net, RacingNews365, Forbes (Oct. 12, 2026)
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Drivers' standings after Singapore GP (Oct. 11):
- Antonelli: 340 points (1st)
- Russell: 238 points (2nd)
- Hamilton: 229 points (3rd)
- Verstappen: 221 points (4th)
- Leclerc: 215 points (5th)
- Norris: 201 points (6th)
- Gap Antonelli → Russell: 102 points (RacingNews365: "extended his 89-point advantage... to 102")
- Antonelli wins in 2026: 7 (confirmed multiple sources)
- He became youngest-ever F1 championship leader (after Japan win)
- US GP dates: Oct. 23-25, 2026 (confirmed formula1.com, multiple sources)
- Points per race maximum: 26 (25 for win + 1 fastest lap)
**MEDIUM confidence:**
- Exact number of remaining races (sources list 6; F1 calendar has ~18 races)
- Austin clinch math (calculated from 102-point gap and 26-pt max per race)

Verstappen Singapore Win
**Source:** PlanetF1, Crash.net, RacingNews365, BeInSports, F1.com official (Oct. 11, 2026)

- Singapore GP result: Verstappen P1, Leclerc P2, Antonelli P3

- 250th GP weekend milestone (confirmed multiple sources)

- Also won Singapore sprint on Oct. 10 from pole
- Russell: sprint DNF (crash leading), race grid penalty 40+ places, finished P9
- Sprint result: Verstappen P1, Hamilton P2 (per Al Jazeera sprint recap)
- Other race positions: Norris P4, Piastri P5, Hamilton P6, Lawson P7, Hülkenberg P8, Russell P9, Hadjar P10
**Notes:** First career Singapore win confirmed by multiple sources ("finally conquers Singapore", "lifts Singapore curse").

- Gap to Antonelli: 102 points after Singapore
- Won Azerbaijan GP in 2026 (confirmed earlier sources)
